F_Academy.name: Rex Fleet Academy
F_Academy.description: Fleet educational institution training pilots, engineers, navigators, technicians, diplomats, administrators, and junior officers through doctrine, history, simulation, and field study.
F_Academy.politicalNotes: Academy instruction treats Reach and Resolve as operational responsibilities that can conflict in practice; the series should show argument, uncertainty, and historical contingency rather than presenting doctrine as unquestionable truth.

F_EarlyRelief.name: Early Multiworld Relief Crew
F_EarlyRelief.description: Mixed post-Break rescue and logistics crews descended from Cooperative, convoy, and Outer Band practices before the mature Rex Fleet exists.
F_EarlyRelief.politicalNotes: This is transitional history. Do not depict a mature Fleet hierarchy or later Crown uniforms.

F_Orison.name: Orison Habitat
F_Orison.description: Highly interdependent orbital settlement whose systems were designed around reliable network replacement, imported food balance, and specialist service access.
F_Orison.politicalNotes: Orison's failure is not laziness or foolishness; its infrastructure was rational under the High Era network and becomes dangerous only after the network disappears.

F_Varda.name: Varda Settlement
F_Varda.description: Self-sufficient post-Break community that preserved itself through local manufacture, agriculture, closed routing, and strong control over outside access.
F_Varda.politicalNotes: Varda's isolation is not caricatured paranoia; it follows real losses from corridor failure. Its danger is that resilience becomes brittle when it rejects useful outside information.
